messages.subject: eqs2lavaan
parts:
I have taken my first crack at actually submitting an R package. The package is called eqs2lavaan and can be found here...

http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/eqs2lavaan/index.html

It is meant more for the EQS user trying to convert to R with the assumption that most models will be relatively standard. I will be looking to add to this with time (i.e. group comparisons and simulations). It could also come in handy if you have old EQS code and don't really feel like transferring it all to lavaan by hand.

What would be a great help however is if you come across an EQS .out file that doesn't convert to lavaan properly, please send me the .out file. I'd like to work more on making sure it hits all the nuances of scripting in EQS. Translation... The package will need some tweaking yet... But with my limited collection of EQS code it works as it should. I would also gladly take any constructive ideas or criticisms. But again, any code for failed conversion would be of the utmost help.

My hope is for at least a couple EQS users to make the switch over to lavaan with the help of this package at some point!

Craig M K
